Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team is excited to trial Redwood for our clinical summarization pilot. Procurement ran the standard terms and a couple of items need an exception before we can sign:

Can you escalate the ask for non-standard termination wording + staged ramp protections to your deal team and legal? We need this approved before procurement will route to DocuSign.

Team — reviewing. Key risk points and proposed language for approval:

Risk: open-ended early termination leads to revenue churn and precedent for other pilots.

Proposed deal-breakers / controls we should include in the addendum:
1) Termination buffer: limited to a single 60-day grace period that can be invoked only once during the pilot and applies only to committed capacity reductions (no immediate credit on historical usage).
2) Staged capacity: 25% / 50% / 100% as requested; commit reductions allowed only at the end of month boundaries with 30 days' notice; opt-out at EOM3 requires KPI failure documented via Redwood's eval report.
3) Financials: one-time onboarding credit of $10,000 (applied to final invoice) and a 10% discount on committed token rate for months 1–3. Total credit cap: $15,000.
4) SLA & data protections: require standard audit logs and SOC2 evidence; Helix has requested extended retention — that will be handled separately by Security but call it out in the SOW.

Approval request: executive sign-off needed on the one-time credit and the 60-day exception. If leadership approves, Legal (Laura) will craft opt-out wording to avoid precedent risk.

Recommend approval subject to: credit cap not to exceed $15k and the 60-day buffer limited to pilot term only.

-Karthik

Alison — thanks for the patience. We've secured internal approval on a limited exception for Helix's pilot. Summary of agreed terms (see attached addendum v3):

- Termination buffer: a single 60-day termination "grace window" available during the 3-month pilot. It can be invoked only once and applies to future committed capacity reductions; historical billed usage is not refunded.
- Ramp schedule: staged commits 25% / 50% / 100% across months 1–3. Opt-out allowed at the end of month 3 IF the KPI gate (latency < 200ms median, error rate < 0.5%, and sample-quality pass per the evaluation set) is not met and only after review of Redwood's evaluation report.
- Financials: one-time onboarding credit $10,000 and 10% discount on committed token rates for months 1–3. Credit cap total $15,000. Credits cannot be combined with other promotional offers.

Next steps: Laura will issue the legal addendum with the exact opt-out wording (attached: helix_addendum_v3.pdf). Once you confirm, we'll send a DocuSign link for signature.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/hellink/abc123

Thanks — looking forward to getting Helix started.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Strategic Accounts
